meta.title: Tamga Network — A shared trust network for the Turkic world
meta.description: Tamga Network is a shared trust network for the Turkic world: digital credentials issued by institutions are verified across borders in seconds, with the person's privacy protected. Open rules, signed lists, EU-compatible.
meta.ogDescription: The modern counterpart of the ancient seal: an open, EU-compatible trust network for the Turkic world.
